title: The Horned Devil Of December

scenes.narration: Heavy chains drag across the frozen cobblestones while a silent, horned figure watches quietly from the deep shadows of the night.
Every single fifth of December, this terrifying companion walks very slowly through the quiet and dark Alpine streets.
Saint Nicholas generously rewards the good children with small gifts while the hairy devil strictly handles the disobedient.
Villagers hear his snake-like tongue lash out in the cold winter air and watch his cloven hoof step firmly onto the porch.
He carries a large wicker basket strapped tightly to his back to cart off naughty children into the freezing alpine night.
When the heavy wooden door finally creaks slowly open, the massive beast stands waiting directly in the dark threshold.
The birch rods are waiting outside, so what would you carefully check first before opening your front door tonight?
